channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Chuck Hayes | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Chuck Hayes from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green
item.description:
Grant Williams on collecting NBA trading cards:

“Allen Iverson, his market has just ballooned over the past year and a half, two years. So that was pretty cool. And then last but not least, I'm actually auctioning one of my two Allen Iverson cards in an auction here in the next couple weeks, which is exciting. I think I had a smaller Chuck Hayes card, which is kind of embarrassing to say. Listen, I love players that were my size and were playing in the league. So like Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Boris Diaw, those were like my favorite players growing up because they looked like me and gave me a chance.”

Grant Williams on Allen Iverson, Boris Diaw, Chuck Hayes, Draymond Green, Sep 27, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Nerlens Noel on Chuck Hayes
item.description:
“I think [general manager] Sam [Hinkie] is looking into that a little more. . . You know Chuck Hayes is a big man and I think it's going to help us.”

Nerlens Noel on Chuck Hayes, Dec 22, 2015. Source: Philadelphia Inquirer.

item.title: Calvin Andrews on Chuck Hayes
item.description:
Mark Berman:Agent Calvin Andrews on Chuck Hayes w/ #Rockets:

“I'm happy. He lives down the street. They said come n. All right be there n a couple of hours”

Calvin Andrews on Chuck Hayes, Nov 1, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Calvin Andrews on Chuck Hayes
item.description:
Mark Berman:Agent Calvin Andrews on FA Chuck Hayes:

“We're still in touch with the #Rockets, but we don't have a timetable for getting something done.”

Calvin Andrews on Chuck Hayes, Jul 18, 2015. Source: Twitter @MarkBermanFox26.

item.title: Geoff Petrie on Chuck Hayes
item.description:
Jason Jones:Petrie on Hayes:

“We’re not going to be able to replace him. He was one of the best defensive frontcourt players in the league and a really unique player we thought would facilitate some offense. We’ll take a look at what we can do but it’s not going to be the same.”

Geoff Petrie on Chuck Hayes, Dec 19, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Paul Westphal on Chuck Hayes
item.description:
Jason Jones:Westphal on Hayes:

“The doctors have to get more information, When we get more information we’ll say something.”

Paul Westphal on Chuck Hayes, Dec 16, 2011. Source: Twitter.
